GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases and Salts 2.5 Rates of Reactions 3.0 Natural P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
